aliases: PS1 J013021+072516 (Rusu et al. 2019, rank C)

catalogue.basis: NOT-ALFOSC resolved spectra, section 4.3.4: 'different emission line profiles, as there is prominent absorption in the CIV and MgII lines of the fainter quasar'; 'likely explained by the system being a projected pair with some small velocity separation'; an archival eBOSS spectrum resolves both absorption doublets; no residuals in PSF-subtracted images
catalogue.limits: 'Intrinsic absorption along different sightlines to the same source quasar cannot necessarily be ruled out.'

later.class: dual quasar (DQ), table 3: dv 900.8 km/s, 17.4 kpc
later.basis: DESI DR1 spectra of A and B (their Palomar DBSP slit was misaligned and the spectra blended); flux ratio shows 'mild fluctuations' near CIV, CIII], MgII; no deflector detected; similar colours
later.limits: 'the LQ hypothesis cannot be completely ruled out'

later.basis: visual inspection of LS DR9 images, model/residual images and DESI DR1 spectra

independent.imaging: HST ACS F814W (GO 17308, 674 s): no light between the images to F814W ~ 23, about 3.5 mag below a typical ordinary lens (repo_HST, injection-calibrated)

J0130+0725.reading: ordinary explanation favoured: projected or dual quasar (two independent authors), with a lens not excluded by either
J0130+0725.missing: an independent velocity or profile difference that absorption cannot explain, e.g. higher-resolution resolved spectra of both components, or two-epoch flux ratios

catalogue.basis: NOT spectra, section 4.3.5: 'small differences in the widths of the CIII] and MgII emission lines'; deep CFHT riz MegaCam data fitted as two PSFs show no obvious lensing galaxy
catalogue.limits: S/N of the NOT spectra not quantified in the text

later.basis: visual; QPC = separation < 2" with two components and no apparent foreground lens

independent.imaging: CFHT MegaCam riz (Lemon2023); archives not checked this round

J0133+0816.reading: open (UQP); line-width differences hint at two quasars but microlensing can change widths
J0133+0816.missing: high-resolution imaging for lens light; higher-S/N resolved spectra

aliases: GraL J0728+2607 (XMM-Newton obs 0902860601, PI Connor, 2022-09-29, 17.2 ks; no published result found)

catalogue.basis: NOT-ALFOSC, section 4.3.11: 'large differences in their emission line profiles and continua, thus making it a likely physical quasar pair'
catalogue.limits: listed under UQP despite the text; differences could in principle be microlensing/extinction

independent.imaging: HST ACS F814W (GO 17308, 674 s): with an empirical PSF no light between the images to F814W ~ 23, at least 1.8 mag below any ordinary lens (repo_HST)

J0728+2607.reading: ordinary explanation favoured: binary quasar (different spectra in an independent data set, and no lens in HST); this was already settled as far as public data go, so this round adds nothing for it
J0728+2607.missing: nothing that is needed for the W2 question; a lens would have to explain both the spectral difference and the missing deflector

catalogue.limits: continuum differences can come from extinction or microlensing in a lens
